result.reasoning_summary: Commit 6eb438b94d2173bc7846a70e8e6af55fb6481cf3 closes all four test gaps identified in the parent FW-ASM-002 review. The patch adds four focused test cases validating error boundaries: boolean observation time rejection, invalid tenant formats, malformed current-time values, and non-JSON fixture serialization. All tests use correct pytest patterns with appropriate exception matching. No production code changed; runtime behavior and authority unchanged. The patch is narrow, deterministic, and directly satisfies the bounded repair milestone requirements. No blocking findings or required tests remain for acceptance.
